title: Lead DevOps Engineer
description:
We Also Walk Dogs needs you to help our clients win fights to make the world a better place.
Our product, ActionKit (actionk.it), is used by dozens of major progressive groups and not-for-profits to stay in touch with tens of millions of online supporters. Our clients use ActionKit to fight climate change, push back against corporate power and more.
We've already begun moving our stack from on-premises servers to AWS, and need a DevOps engineer to help us take that effort to the next level. If you'd like to work at the intersection of cool cloud tech and making a better world, this is the job for you.
ActionKit is built by We Also Walk Dogs. Named after a Robert Heinlein story about a company that specialized in solving impossible problems, We Also Walk Dogs has spent over a decade serving online progressive organizations and charities. We're a small, friendly, and clever company. And we all work remotely.
Is this the job for you?

• Do you keep production systems running? According to our external monitoring, we've kept 99.98% uptime this past year, and gone three months without downtime, while very actively working on the product. We need someone with the expertise and discipline to help us keep that going.

• Do you think in the cloud? After starting with a fully on-premises deployment, today we're serving millions of end-users from AWS. But we know that intelligently deploying new tools and cloud capabilities can help us do things we could never do with just a rack of servers, and we need a DevOps engineer who can take us there.

• Can you can wear a lot of hats? We're a small company and not much for bureaucratic divisions. The boss codes; the project manager gives sales demos; most everyone, including you, does a shift of at least a few hours each week answering our clients' support tickets.

If this sounds like you, please apply!
Must haves:

• You need to care about maintaining a high-quality deployment. We've kept our uptime record with solid automation and monitoring, jumping on oddities before they become problems, and digging into root causes when things go wrong. We need you to be able to continue that tradition.

• You need vision as well as execution. We need you to not only keep things running smoothly, but also help lead us where we need to go next. You need expertise in modern tools and AWS capabilities, and a strategic sense of how we can use them for efficiency, manageability, performance, and reliability.

• You need to be in touch with others' needs. We're a small, tight-knit crew where everyone pitches in. Empathy with clients and end-users is also core to our business. Everyone on the team works directly with clients.

Nice to haves:

• Experience working with all-remote teams.

• Experience with Django, MySQL, and Ansible.

• Experience with AWS features and patterns like VPCs, ELBs, SQS, auto-scaling groups, multi-zone deployments, and so on.

• That said, experience with our stack is maybe the least important factor here; Even if you've used Rails instead of Django, Postgres instead of MySQL, or Azure instead of AWS, we want to hear from you.

Why work for us?

• Competitive salary. We are a self-funded, for-profit company.

• Remote work. Hours and location are flexible as long as you get the work done. In this day and age you shouldn't have to relocate to San Francisco for awesome work.

• Four weeks paid time off. We encourage you to take vacation; we are not the sort of workplace that pressures anyone into 60-hour weeks.

• A free, great health insurance policy and 401(k)

• Work with an awesome team for awesome causes.

title: Senior Product Manager II, Consumer (all genders)
description:
The role

HelloFresh serves millions of customers weekly across 18 business units and 8 brands worldwide. At the heart of our product is a belief that every customer deserves a menu that feels like it was made for them, the right meals, at the right time, for the right person. We call it the Sous Chef vision.

As Senior PM II on the Personalization Experience team , you own what makes that vision real and  felt . You're not building the ranking algorithm, you're building the experiences that make customers trust it, the data collection that makes it smart, and the moments where someone thinks: this app actually knows me .

This is a high-autonomy role at the intersection of consumer UX, engineering, and ML systems. The problems are genuinely hard, the scale is real, and the decisions are yours to make.

What you’ll do

• Food Profile Quality & Signal Collection: The food profile is the raw material that powers everything downstream. Your job is to move customers from "fields filled in" to truly Personalization-Ready: high-signal, validated, actionable. You'll own and iterate on the collection experiences that give our models the data they need to perform.

• The "Sous Chef" Feel & Transparency: You build the moments where personalization becomes tangible, the places where we tell customers why certain meals were chosen for them. This isn't just UX work, it's trust infrastructure for the entire personalization stack.

• Cross-Org Data Supplier : You're the clean, reliable interface between raw signal and downstream experience, owning the explanation payloads and API contracts that make it all work at scale. You operate across organizational boundaries and align on shared metrics without needing to own the surfaces.

• AI-Native Discovery You use GenAI tools actively to compress discovery-to-decision cycles, synthesizing global customer signals, stress-testing hypotheses, and arriving at decision-ready specs faster than traditional PM workflows allow. You don't treat AI as a novelty; it's a genuine speed and quality multiplier in your daily practice.

• Long-Horizon Strategy You manage your domain with real autonomy. You run a flywheel: better profile data → better models → more visible personalization → more signal back to personalization. You own the strategy and sequencing, not just the backlog, thinking 12-18 months out and making the calls that shape the direction of the team.

What you’ll bring

• Deep personalization or data-collection PM experience. 5+ years of PM experience, with meaningful time on user-facing personalization or data collection products, ideally where the UX is the data pipeline, and where you've shipped for both end customers and downstream data consumers.

• Strong product taste and customer-facing craft. You have a genuine feel for what makes a consumer experience compelling, trustworthy, and sticky, not just functional. You've built products at scale where millions of people interact with what you ship, and you hold a high bar for the details: the copy, the interaction pattern, the moment of delight. You know the difference between a feature that works and one that earns trust.

• Data-native. You query your own data (SQL/Python), define your own input/output KPIs, and hold your own in deep-dive technical discussions without needing a data analyst to translate.

• Cross-org credibility. You've shipped products across organizational boundaries, aligning on shared metrics, maintaining clean contracts with engineering partners, and navigating competing priorities without direct authority.

• Experimentation with healthy skepticism. You design experiments to validate hypotheses and know how to interpret results without over-indexing on noise. You've made hard calls to kill features based on data.

• Exceptional communicator. You can make a complex algorithmic concept legible to a non-technical VP and you can write a spec that engineers can actually ship from.

title: Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) - Engineering Productivity
description:

Arista Networks is looking for a skilled professional for our Engineering Productivity (EngProd) team to help maintain and support our rapidly expanding infrastructure and internal user base. The ideal candidate is someone who can wear many hats, is versatile and is enthusiastic about learning new technologies. As a part of the software engineering team, you will work with other team members to design, build and administer secure, scalable and fault-tolerant tools and infrastructure in a hybrid cloud environment.
Working in the EngProd group, you will collaborate and work with other engineers to design, build, scale, and operate the systems used by Arista’s product development teams. Thes systems are based on industry-standards, including Ansible, Artifactory, Gerrit, Jenkins, Kubernetes, Grafana, Spinnaker, MySQL, ElasticSearch, Google Cloud, Varnish, Perforce, Gerrit etc, 3rd party storage appliances, as well as internal systems developed from the ground-up to automate CI/CD, testing, analysis, and visualization.
What You'll Do

• Build, deploy safely and incrementally and operate critical production systems with focus on scalability, reliability, observability, performance and security.

• Monitor, support and enhance developer experience across services.

• Build automation to remove toil and efficiently operate production systems.

• Proactively monitor, respond to, and enhance alerts and set up automated alert handling

• Create and maintain the incident response runbooks.

• Build and deploy new systems with scalability, reliability, and observability as primary requirements

• Triage platform/infrastructural issues and help Arista software engineers in their triages. Engage with 3rd party vendor support.

• Deploy new systems in a staged manner

• Write postmortem documents and build solutions to avoid incidents from repeating.

• Plan and communicate maintenance windows on production systems.

• Work with Arista’s product development teams to identify infrastructural issues that are causing bottlenecks and limitations in their workflows. Design and implement solutions to resolve them.

• Survey and adopt best practices around infrastructure/platform to maintain secure, scalable and fault-tolerant systems.

• Implement solutions to scale the systems

• Implement fault-tolerance and performance to improve availability of the systems

• Study the design and sufficient implementation details of OSS systems for better triage and fix resolution.

Essential to have all of the following skills

• At least BSc Computer Science or Engineering + 5 years’ experience, MS Computer Science or Engineering + 5 years’ experience, or equivalent work experience.

• Knowledge of one or more of Go, Python, shell scripting to be able to implement medium complexity automation workflows.

• Knowledge of Linux (or UNIX) from administration and debugging perspective

• Hands-on experience in operating software systems (infrastructure, complex applications etc) at scale

• Experience in server provisioning (esp from storage and networking perspective).

• Strong problem solving and software troubleshooting skills

• Experience with infrastructure-as-code

Desirable to have one/more of the following skills

• Experience managing databases - mariadb, postgres, mongodb etc

• Experience with docker and virtualization technologies - kvm, qemu, kata-containers etc

• Experience managing monitoring stack - Prometheus, Loki, Tempo, InfluxDB, Grafana, Thanos etc

• Experience managing ElasticSearch clusters

• Experience managing Artifactory, docker registry etc

• Experience managing CI/CD systems like ArgoCD, Spinnaker etc

• Experience managing version control systems like Perforce, Gerrit etc

• Experience with infrastructure-as-code frameworks like Ansible

title: Server Engineering Manager, Member Experience
description:
In a world where many social apps measure their success by time spent online, Raya is a technology company focused on providing utility. Our iOS only app is a tool for discovery of and access to exciting people, events, opportunities, and recommendations globally. We believe that by marrying great software with a membership based community built around core values of trust, creativity, and reciprocity, we can provide solutions that have heretofore been impossible.

We are seeking an Engineering Manager to lead our Member Experience server team. Member Experience owns the full member lifecycle - from a prospective member's first application through onboarding, payments, and renewal month after month. That surface spans application and acceptance, authentication and login, onboarding, subscriptions and in-app purchases including Raya +, reactivation and referrals, and member communications. These are net-new payment systems built for scale rather than legacy systems in maintenance, with high ownership and direct revenue impact.

The ideal candidate will have at least 2 years of experience managing software development teams, with deep knowledge of Node.js and TypeScript, and should be familiar with cloud architectures, services, deployment models, and distributed systems. We value strong project management skills and the ability to deliver on commitments. In this role, you will work closely with leadership, product managers, designers, and data team stakeholders to deliver business impact.

We offer comprehensive medical and dental coverage, $50 a day food delivery budget, equity based employment, a great culture, learning opportunities, unlimited vacation, 12 weeks paid parental leave, and we pay all employees $1,000 a year to go somewhere in the world that they've never been because of our values of human connection, empathy, and curiosity.

Responsibilities

• Manage, mentor, and grow a team of server engineers, including hiring, onboarding, and career development, while fostering a high-performance and collaborative culture.

• Contribute to the codebase and provide technical leadership across architecture, system design, and key engineering decisions.

• Partner with product, design, and data to define, scope, and deliver high-impact features, owning execution from concept through launch.

• Oversee the development and continuous enhancement of scalable, secure, and efficient services in a cloud environment, and uphold a high bar for engineering quality - code standards, testing practices, operational readiness, and long-term maintainability.

• Operate as a player/coach with an expected ~50% hands-on engineering contribution.

Requirements

• Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a similar field, or equivalent industry experience.

• 2+ years of experience managing high-performing engineering teams.

• Deep knowledge of Node.js and TypeScript, with familiarity across cloud architecture, services, deployment models, and distributed systems. Our stack includes MongoDB and PostgreSQL.

• Production experience with Apple StoreKit payments and subscriptions, and production experience with Stripe payments and subscriptions for a B2C product.

• Experience serving within and administering an operational excellence program: production readiness, observability, on call.

• Proven ability to lead projects from concept through launch, balancing speed and quality, and to collaborate effectively with cross-functional partners to deliver business impact.

• Experience sourcing, screening, hiring, mentoring, and developing engineers, with strong communication and leadership skills.

• An AI-forward mindset, with curiosity about applying emerging technologies to improve developer and product experiences.

title: Software Engineer, Platform

What You Will Be Doing

- Own the full sales cycle for both new and existing accounts in your territory - first conversation through security review, procurement, and close, on Cloud commitments and multi-year committed spend.

- Grow your install base by landing new teams and new use cases inside accounts that already buy from us.

- Find and convert existing ClickHouse usage in new accounts. Unmanaged open-source deployments and self-serve Cloud accounts are the highest-yield source of new pipeline in this segment.

- Multi-thread across the data platform team, the budget owner, security, and the executive sponsor rather than relying on a single champion.

- Enough technical fluency to hold an architecture conversation. You don't need to write SQL, but you should be able to explain why a company moves a workload off Elasticsearch.

- Experience with consumption-based or usage-metered commercial models, where revenue moves with usage between contract events.

- Experience selling into developer-led, bottom-up adoption as well as top-down.

Mangobeds is a property management system for colivings, hostels, hotels, campsites, glamping sites, cabins, retreats, surf stays, villas and vacation rentals, from small independents to large operators running 10 to 200 units. We have paying customers across Europe, the Americas and Asia, and we are looking for self-employed sales reps to bring us more.

THE DEAL
- Commission-only. You earn 30% of everything a customer you bring pays us in their first 12 months, rising to 35% and then 40% as you close more.
- Paid monthly, within 15 days of month end, once the customer has been with us for one month. No long vesting, no quarterly wait.
- Customers on annual plans pay the full year up front, so a single close can mean one large payment landing within 30 days.
- You find the properties yourself. You choose the markets and the operators you go after, and we back you with full product access, demos and pricing support whenever you need them.
- You keep your other clients. The only restriction is not selling for a competing property management system.
- Fully remote, your own hours, no quotas, no daily activity reports.

YOU WOULD BE A GOOD FIT IF
- You have sold software, travel or hospitality services before and can run your own pipeline end to end.
- You know the coliving, hostel, hotel or holiday rental world, or you will learn it fast. Experience selling to larger operators and multi-property groups counts for most here.
- You are self-employed and can invoice us.
- You speak English, plus any of Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, French or German.

ONE HOUSE RULE
If another rep is already working an account, you cannot jump on it. Ask us and we will tell you who has what.

WHAT YOU GET FROM US
- Full access to the product, a demo property, recorded walkthroughs and a deck.
- A Mangobeds email address and direct access to the founder for demos and pricing questions.
- Honest answers. We will tell you what does not work yet, so you never sell something we cannot deliver.

About us    

Founded in 2017, Wayve is the leading developer of Embodied AI technology.  Our advanced AI software and foundation models enable vehicles to perceive, understand, and navigate any complex environment, enhancing the usability and safety of automated driving systems.

Our vision is to create autonomy that propels the world forward.  Our intelligent, mapless, and hardware-agnostic AI products are designed for automakers, accelerating the transition from assisted to automated driving. 

In our fast-paced environment big problems ignite us-we embrace uncertainty, leaning into complex challenges to unlock groundbreaking solutions. We aim high and stay humble in our pursuit of excellence, constantly learning and evolving as we pave the way for a smarter, safer future.

At Wayve, your contributions matter.  We value diversity, embrace new perspectives, and foster an inclusive work environment; we back each other to deliver impact.  

Make Wayve the experience that defines your career!  

About the role

We are looking for an ML Software Engineer to join the Multi-Embodiment Generalist Agent (MEGA) team within Wayve Science as a founding member.

MEGA is building foundation models for general-purpose robots: models that learn from large-scale video, language, and robot-interaction data, then generalize across tasks and embodiments-including mobile manipulators, dual-arm platforms, and humanoids. Our aim is to build agents that can perceive, reason about, and act reliably in the physical world.

You will design and build the software systems that enable MEGA's machine learning research. This includes scalable ML pipelines, data and training infrastructure, and the shared tools and abstractions that allow researchers to move quickly from an idea to a reliable experiment.

The role sits close to the models and data. You will work with large-scale video and robotics datasets, modern ML frameworks, and increasingly large models, building systems that remain reliable and maintainable as the research program grows. A major part of the role will be designing and maintaining robust workflows and reusable infrastructure that can support multiple ML projects. This emphasis on infrastructure, software systems, repo health, testing and maintainability is central to the role.

You will be a core member of the MEGA team, owning key parts of the software and ML infrastructure that underpin the research program. You will work directly on the systems used to build, train, evaluate, and scale our models, and help shape how the team develops and operates its ML stack as the program grows.

 

Key Responsibilities

• Design, build, and maintain scalable ML pipelines for data ingestion, model training, evaluation, and related research workflows.

• Build software systems that allow ML workloads to scale to larger datasets, larger models, and more experiments.

• Develop clean and reusable interfaces between data, models, training, evaluation, and downstream robotics workflows.

• Own and improve the health of the MEGA codebase, including software architecture, testing, reliability, maintainability, and engineering standards.

• Identify and resolve performance, reliability, and usability bottlenecks across ML workflows.

• Build and maintain infrastructure that supports multiple researchers and ML projects without unnecessarily slowing down iteration.

• Work closely with researchers to understand the requirements of new models and experiments, and translate those requirements into practical software solutions.

• Build and use distributed training and data-processing pipelines for large models and large multimodal datasets.

About You

In order to set you up for success as an ML Software Engineer at Wayve, we're looking for the following skills and experience.

Essential

• Strong software engineering skills and experience building high-quality, maintainable software.

• Experience

title: Senior Cryptography Engineer
description:
About IonQ: 

IonQ, Inc . [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance .

Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.  

Location: This role is based onsite in Geneva, Switzerland.
Travel:  
Job ID: 1893 

ID Quantique (IDQ), part of IonQ, is a global leader in quantum-safe communications. We provide solutions to protect governments, telecommunication infrastructures, and banking & financial institutions from the “harvest-now, decrypt-later” threat, delivering both terrestrial and space-based quantum-safe networks in live operation globally.

The Role: 

We are looking for a Staff Cryptography Engineer to join our team building post-quantum cryptography (PQC) hardware acceleration for HSM and network-appliance products. You will implement the software side of modern post-quantum algorithms: reference models, optimised implementations, and the test infrastructure that proves they are correct. This is a hands-on development role at the heart of applied cryptography, working with some of the most experienced cryptographic engineers in the field.

Responsibilities :

You will implement and maintain reference and bit-accurate models of ML-KEM, ML-DSA and SLH-DSA/LMS in C/C++/Rust and Python, develop constant-time software implementations of cryptographic functions, and build out the known-answer-test and test-vector tooling (NIST ACVP) used for verification and CAVP certification. You will contribute to the decomposition of algorithms into hardware-friendly building blocks (Keccak, NTT and polynomial arithmetic, samplers, encode/decode), support RTL and firmware engineers with algorithm questions and debugging, and help evaluate third-party cryptographic libraries, working under the guidance of our senior cryptography engineers.

• Implement reference models, optimised software and test-vector infrastructure for ML-KEM, ML-DSA and SLH-DSA/LMS

• Support hardware and firmware teams with algorithm expertise, debugging and certification-oriented tooling

Requirements:

We are looking for a candidate with a Master’s degree (PhD a plus) in Cryptography, Mathematics, Computer Science or a related field and at least five years of experience implementing cryptographic algorithms or security-critical software in C/C++ or Rust. You have solid understanding of modern cryptographic primitives and ideally first exposure to post-quantum schemes (lattice-based or hash-based) and their underlying mathematics.

You care about correctness and write well-tested, readable code; you understand what constant-time implementation means and why it matters. Familiarity with NIST test-vector formats, CAVP/ACVP or certification-oriented development is a plus. Fluency in English is required; French or German is an advantage.

• Hands-on developer of cryptographic or security-critical software with strong C/C++/Rust skills

• Solid cryptographic foundations with the ambition to build deep post-quantum expertise

Supporting approximately 1,000 employees across multiple states, this role handles the hands-on execution that keeps benefits accurate and compliant in every jurisdiction we operate in, and keeps our HR data clean, secure, and reportable.
This is a senior individual contributor role. You will work with meaningful independence on established programs and processes, escalating plan design decisions, budget commitments, and novel compliance questions to the Manager or Director. It suits someone who takes real satisfaction in getting the details right - reconciling a carrier file, catching an eligibility error before it becomes a claim problem, and explaining a deductible clearly to an employee who is worried about a bill. This person works independently, knows when to escalate, and maintains accuracy and composure during high-volume periods.
Requirements
Benefits Administration

• Administer all health and welfare plans day to day, including medical, dental, vision, HSA/FSA, life and AD&D, short- and long-term disability, EAP, and voluntary benefits.

• Process enrollments, qualifying life events, terminations, and COBRA notifications; audit for accuracy and timeliness.

Work from leave status, type, and dates provided by HR Business Partners, who own leave administration.

• Support the annual renewal cycle by compiling census, claims, and utilization data for the broker and Manager, and by preparing analysis to inform plan design and contribution recommendations.

• Administer the 401(k) plan operationally: contribution and loan feeds, eligibility and enrollment monitoring, and preparation of data for nondiscrimination testing, Form 5500, and the annual plan audit.

• Serve as first-line support for employee benefits questions, claims issues, and eligibility inquiries; escalate complex disputes and exception requests.

• Maintain vendor relationships at the service level - open and track tickets, hold carriers to service standards, and flag performance concerns to the Manager.

HRIS Administration & Reporting

• Serve as primary day-to-day administrator for UKG: process transactions, maintain configuration within established design, manage security role assignments, and test releases.

• Maintain data integrity through recurring audits, validation checks, and reconciliation across HRIS, payroll, benefits carriers, and the 401(k) recordkeeper.

• Monitor integrations and EDI feeds to downstream systems; triage failures, resolve routine errors, and escalate structural issues to the Manager and vendor support.

• Audit that leave status changes entered by HR Business Partners flow correctly through to benefits eligibility and carrier feeds, and flag gaps before they result in a coverage lapse.

• Build and maintain standard and ad hoc reports and dashboards - headcount, turnover, benefits enrollment and cost, and EEO and compliance reporting.

• Contribute to system projects and module rollouts as a functional resource: document current-state processes, write test scripts, execute testing, and support training and go-live.

• Create and maintain process documentation and job aids; train HR partners, managers, and employees on self-service functionality.

You’ll manage and grow our existing partnerships, identify where the Market should expand, and source and close the partners that can get us there. You’ll build deep relationships with our partners and look for opportunities to expand what we can do together, both within the Market and across Thatch.

This is a high-ownership role with the opportunity to shape what Thatch Market becomes as we scale.

What you will do

• Own our partner ecosystem. Manage our portfolio of Market partners, from performance and ongoing relationships to renewals, growth opportunities, and offboarding.

• Figure out what’s next. Understand what our members need, identify gaps in the Market, and determine which partners and categories we should pursue.

• Bring great partners to Thatch. Source, pitch, negotiate, and close strategic healthcare and service partners.

• Build partnerships that make sense. Structure commercial models that work for Thatch and our partners, with a clear understanding of the economics and tradeoffs behind them.

• Make partnerships work in practice. Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, and other teams to launch new partnerships, solve problems, and make them successful over time. 

What we're looking for

• 4+ years of experience in strategic partnerships, business development, or a similar role, ideally in technology.

• A track record of personally sourcing, negotiating, and closing strategic partnerships.

• Experience building and owning strong partner relationships after launch and growing them over time.

• Strong commercial judgment and comfort navigating deal structure, economics, and tradeoffs.

• The ability to see beyond the immediate deal and identify broader opportunities for a partnership.

• Strong cross-functional skills and the ability to move work forward across multiple teams. 

Experience that stands out

• Experience in healthcare, benefits, fintech, or another complex industry.

• Experience building partnerships that are closely connected to a product or customer experience.

• Experience working closely with Product and Engineering to turn partner needs into scalable solutions.

• Unshakable optimism in the face of adversity.

How we work

• We give people ownership and trust them to make good decisions.

• We move quickly, learn from customers, and improve continuously.

• We solve hard problems together, regardless of team or title.

• We care more about building the right thing than following a perfect process.

What to expect

• An initial conversation with a recruiter.

title: Senior Product Marketing Manager (Physical AI & Autonomy)
description:
About the Role at RobCo

RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works.

 

THE ROLE

This is a senior, high-trust role owning the product narrative for Alfie, RobCo's flagship Physical AI product line - the fastest-moving, highest-margin part of our business and the centerpiece of our category leadership story. You'll sit at the intersection of Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing - with a named Product counterpart and a standing seat at roadmap and design reviews.

You'll also carry a rare kind of stakes: Alfie debuts publicly at RobCoN in March 2027 - the biggest product launch in RobCo's history. Getting there is a multi-month campaign spanning film, digital, and physical activation, and you will own video production for Alfie end-to-end across it. This is the kind of launch most product marketers wait a career for.

We care more about how well you understand the technology - and the people selling it - than about your marketing pedigree. If you've spent years elbow-deep in robotics, automation, or industrial engineering, and you have a real talent for explaining complex things clearly - to a sales rep, a customer, or a skeptical engineer - we want to hear from you. A background in Product Marketing is a plus, not a prerequisite.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Own the Alfie & Physical AI Narrative

- Develop the core messaging and positioning for Alfie - value props, differentiators, use cases - and own the framework that Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and External Comms all draw from.

- Translate complex robotics and AI concepts into language that lands with the audience in front of you, whether that's a plant manager, a procurement lead, or a skeptical engineer.

2. Content & Sales Enablement

- Own the Alfie whitepaper, technical datasheets, solution briefs, and use case fact sheets - written to be used, not filed away.

- Build and own the Alfie sales enablement deck, competitive battlecards, and demo scripts - and drive adoption to 100% among Alfie-selling AEs, not just ship-and-hope.

- Run enablement sessions so commercial teams can articulate Alfie's value confidently and consistently.

3. A Real Seat at the Product Table

- Named Product/Engineering counterpart and a recurring, calendar-mandated syncs.

- Standing invite to Alfie roadmap - access by default.

- Close the loop: bring field and customer insight back into Product, and get roadmap context out to Sales before it's old news.

5. RobCoN Launch & Content Production

- Own video production for Alfie end-to-end - from the recurring proof-point films that build the campaign through to the flagship film that plays live on the RobCoN stage.

- Drive Alfie's presence across the full run-up to RobCoN - our biggest product launch to date - partnering closely with Product and external creative partners to ship against a fixed, public-facing calendar.

- Own the RobCoN messaging framework and speaker briefing materials, and help shape how the live stage moments land.

- This is a high-visibility, high-stakes mandate: the work you ship here will be seen by the entire company, our customers, and the market, at the most important moment in RobCo's history so far.

We're Looking for Someone Who Has

- 6+ years of relevant experience - this can be Product Marketing, but just as easily Pre-Sales/Solutions Engineering, Applications Engineering, Technical Consulting, Product Management, or a hands-on role in robotics, automation, or industrial tech. We're hiring for depth of technical understanding first.

- Real fluency in robotics, automation, mechatronics, industrial hardware/software systems, or AI - gained on the job, not just in a classroom.

- A track record of turning technical complexity into content

description:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

About The Role:

Kong is building Project Volcano, an internal developer platform purpose-built for Kong's engineering ecosystem. Volcano will provide teams with on-demand preview environments, edge deployments, managed PostgreSQL, auth, realtime, and storage APIs all deeply integrated with Kong products.

As the Senior SRE for Volcano, you will be the reliability voice for this platform. This role is a strategic initiative driven by the Office of the CTO (OCTO). You will partner directly with engineering leadership to define the platform's reliability posture. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role with direct influence on Kong's next generation developer platform.

 

What You'll Do:

- Own reliability for Volcano end-to-end: Define and drive SLOs, error budgets, and incident response practices for all Volcano services - edge deployments, managed Postgres, auth, realtime, storage, and the control plane.

- Contribute to the platform's infrastructure: Design and build the multi-region Kubernetes infrastructure, networking, and data plane that powers Volcano's edge deployment pipeline and backend-as-a-service capabilities.

- Build the GitOps and CI/CD backbone: Establish deployment automation, canary pipelines, and preview environment provisioning using ArgoCD, Helm, and Terraform/Terragrunt - setting patterns the broader team will follow.

- Scale managed data services: Design, operate, and harden multi-tenant PostgreSQL clusters, Redis caching layers, and object storage - with a focus on data isolation, performance, and disaster recovery.

- Drive observability from day one: Instrument every Volcano service with meaningful SLIs; build dashboards, alerts, and runbooks using Datadog, Prometheus, and Grafana before services go live, not after incidents.

- Lead cross-functional reliability work: Collaborate with the OCTO team, product engineering, and security to bake reliability and compliance into Volcano's architecture - not bolt it on later.

- Evaluate and adopt emerging technologies: Given Volcano's greenfield nature, evaluate and make architectural decisions on edge runtimes, serverless compute, vector databases, and AI-native infrastructure components.

 

What You'll Bring:

- BS in Computer Science or equivalent; substantial experience at Staff or Principal IC level in SRE/Platform Engineering.

- Proven track record building SRE or platform engineering practices for developer-facing platforms or PaaS/SaaS products - ideally at greenfield stage.

- Kubernetes expertise: multi-tenant cluster design, networking (CNI, service mesh, ingress), autoscaling, and security hardening.

About the Role

Elite Editing is seeking experienced freelance journalists and content professionals to support our growing customer reference and case study programs. We call this our Storyteller role, and we are specifically looking for experienced professionals based in EMEA and APAC time zones .

Our Storytellers own the storytelling process from interview through finished draft. They lead kickoff calls with our clients and their internal stakeholders, interview their customers and subject matter experts (SMEs), identify the strongest narrative angles within the information they gather, and then write compelling case studies and customer reference stories that adhere to client-specific standards and style guides.

This is more than simply working through a list of prepared questions-or turning a transcript into copy. We need skilled storytellers who listen closely, recognize when an answer deserves further exploration, ask intelligent follow-up questions, identify the details that make a story worth telling, and then shape that material into polished, engaging content.

Our ideal freelancer has a journalism or professional interviewing background paired with extensive professional writing experience and strong editorial judgment . You should be comfortable speaking with senior business leaders, technical SMEs, and other professionals; able to quickly understand unfamiliar or complex subject matter; and skilled at transforming what you learn into a clear and compelling narrative.

What You'll Do

You will:

• Conduct virtual kickoff calls with client stakeholders to understand the goals, context, audience, and desired direction of customer reference stories.

• Use provided interview guides as a starting point while adapting questions to the conversation.

• Ask thoughtful, unscripted follow-up questions that uncover meaningful details, examples, outcomes, challenges, and quotable insights.

• Identify and develop the strongest story angles from interviews, background materials, and client input.

• Write polished B2B case studies and customer reference stories based on the information you gather, following client-specific briefs, templates, standards, and style guides.

• Synthesize complex or technical information into accurate, accessible, and engaging narratives for the intended audience.

• Maintain a professional, confident, and personable presence while representing Elite and our clients on calls.

• Work collaboratively with Elite's project managers, editors, and other members of the content team throughout the development and revision process.

• Follow client-specific processes, confidentiality requirements, and project instructions.

Job Requirements

Successful candidates must:

• Have substantial professional writing experience , with a portfolio demonstrating the ability to develop clear, engaging, publication-ready content.

• Have professional experience conducting interviews, preferably in journalism, B2B content, tech, publishing, corporate communications, or a related field .

• Be an exceptional listener who can think on their feet and pursue useful lines of questioning in real time.

• Be able to absorb unfamiliar information quickly and ask credible, informed questions about complex topics.

title: Sales Representative (m/w/d) - Heidelberg
description:
Du hast erste Vertriebserfahrung und willst jetzt richtig loslegen? Bei uns bekommst du ein strukturierteres Onboarding, dein eigenes Gebiet, kurze Sales-Cycles und ein Team, das dich weiterentwickelt.

Salonkee ist Marktführer für Salon-Software in Luxemburg, Belgien und der Schweiz. Über 10.000 Beauty- und Wellness-Betriebe in sieben Ländern nutzen unsere All-in-one-Software - von der Terminbuchung über die Kundenverwaltung und die Kasse bis hin zu Marketing- und KI-Funktionen.

Für einen Salon bedeutet das im Schnitt 70% weniger Terminausfälle und 8 bis 12 Stunden weniger Verwaltungsaufwand pro Woche.

DEINE ROLLE

- Du gehst aktiv auf Saloninhaber:innen in deiner Region zu - telefonisch, per Walk-in oder über Social Media (Kaltakquise).

- Vor Ort ermittelst du den Bedarf des Salons mithilfe von Fragen und zeigst anhand von Produktdemos, wie Salonkee den Alltag vereinfachen kann.

- Du verantwortest deinen eigenen Funnel vom Erstkontakt bis zum Abschluss.

- Du planst deine Woche eigenverantwortlich, mit klaren Zielen und einer Führungskraft, die dich unterstützt und weiterentwickelt.

DAS BRINGST DU MIT

- Nachweisbare erste Erfahrung im Vertrieb, idealerweise mit Outbound-Anteil (Kaltakquise, Walk-ins, eigene Terminierung).

- Du bist kontaktfreudig und gehst gerne in den Austausch - egal ob am Telefon oder direkt vor Ort.

- Du bist in der Lage, Menschen zu begeistern und Interessen zu wecken.

- Du kannst mit Ablehnung umgehen und richtest den Blick nach vorn.

- Du bist lernbereit, setzt Feedback um und willst dich weiterentwickeln.

- Du bist strukturiert und organisiert.

- Du bist sicher im Umgang mit digitalen Tools.

- Verhandlungssicheres bis muttersprachliches Deutsch sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

- Führerschein der Klasse B und Freude daran, in deiner Region unterwegs zu sein.

DAS ERWARTET DICH BEI UNS

- Ein Team vor Ort: Team Lead und Kolleg:innen in deiner Region - du startest nicht allein.

- Strukturierte Einarbeitung und praxisnahe Begleitung über die ersten Monate hinweg (Ramp-Up Programm).

- Ein klarer Entwicklungspfad: Von Junior- über Senior- und bis hin zu Führungsrollen..

- Klare KPIs & Performance-Transparenz, damit du jederzeit weißt, wo du stehst.

- Eigenverantwortliche Wochenplanung und Vertrauensarbeitszeit.

- Firmenwagen inkl. Tankkarte sowie MacBook und iPhone.

- 50 € steuerfreies Guthaben pro Monat über Probonio.

- Fixgehalt und ungedeckelte Provision.

- Teamevents, die den Namen verdienen: Sommerfest, Winterfeier und regelmäßige Team-Formate.

WIE GEHT ES WEITER?

1. Bewerbung & Sichtung - wir melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei dir.

2. Erstgespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team (ca. 30-45 Minuten).

3. Video-Call mit deiner künftigen Führungskraft.

4. Field Day - zwei Stunden bei uns im Office. Du siehst, wie wir arbeiten, wir sehen dich in Aktion.

5. Abschlussgespräch mit unserer Head of Sales.

Salonkee steht für Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten - unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Behinderung, Religion oder Identität.
